gentle.label: Gentle
gentle.description: Low impact, chair-supported options. Good for beginners, returning after a break, or sore days.

standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Bodyweight strength and cardio at a steady pace.

squat.cue: Chest up, weight through your heels.

push.cue: Keep a straight line from head to hips.

lunge.cue: Front knee tracks over your toes.

core.cue: Breathe steadily; don’t hold your breath.

cardio.cue: Find a rhythm you could keep talking through.

bridge.cue: Squeeze at the top; keep ribs down.

back.cue: Lift long, not high. Keep your neck neutral.

series.title: Renewed Strength
series.summary: Seven days for anyone feeling worn out. Strength comes from God first; we just show up.

days.title: Wait and renew
days.verse: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
days.reflection: Where are you running on your own strength? Offer that area to God before you move.

days.title: Strength in Christ
days.verse: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
days.reflection: This verse was written about contentment in hard seasons. What would contentment look like in your body today?

days.title: Grace in weakness
days.verse: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.
days.reflection: Pick the level that matches today, not the one that impresses anyone. Weakness is a place God meets you.

days.title: Strength of my heart
days.verse: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
days.reflection: When your legs want to quit, what does it mean that God is your portion?

days.title: Joy as strength
days.verse: Neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
days.reflection: Play your favorite worship song today. Notice one thing you can thank God for in your body.

days.title: Courage
days.verse: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
days.reflection: What is one thing you have been afraid to start? Name it in prayer during your rest breaks.

days.title: Rest
days.verse: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
days.reflection: Rest is obedience, not laziness. Move gently and give God the week behind you.

series.title: Temple Stewardship
series.summary: Seven days on caring for your body as a gift you manage for God, not a project for the mirror.

days.title: Not your own
days.verse: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own? For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s.
days.reflection: If your body is on loan from God, what is one way you’d care for it differently this week?

days.title: A living sacrifice
days.verse: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
days.reflection: Offer this workout to God at the start, the way you’d offer a prayer.

days.title: Eat and drink to his glory
days.verse: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
days.reflection: Plan one simple, nourishing meal for today. Give thanks before you eat it.

days.title: Godliness first
days.verse: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
days.reflection: Training has value, and godliness has more. Keep today’s session short and spend the extra minutes in prayer.

days.title: Run with patience
days.verse: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us.
days.reflection: What weight, habit or distraction do you need to set down this week?

days.title: Discipline
days.verse: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.
days.reflection: Discipline is choosing what matters most over what you want right now. Where is that choice today?

days.title: As to the Lord
days.verse: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men.
days.reflection: Finish the week with your full heart. Who could you invite to join you next week?
